- [NCBK.1.2] **First arg is the engine handle.** Every public surface is
  engine-scoped, no globals ([IARC.1.11]). The handle names the engine that
  fired the callback; it is not a way back into that engine. Every
  `ds_engine_*` call on it from inside the callback, a read as well as a
  write, returns `DS_ERR_STATE` ([RARC.13.16]). A callback may call into a
  different engine.
